id: title:Gilbert09:recover when a resumed listing cursor is gone

review.posthog_relevance: Stripe warehouse ingestion recovery and pagination cursor handling
review.reason: The change replaces a direct Stripe API call with a helper and adds a recovery loop for pagination cursors. P1.F1.H1 shows the implementation of clearing the stale cursor and restarting the listing when Stripe returns a resource-missing error, while P1.F2.H1 adds a test asserting this behavior. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in the reliability of the Stripe-to
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on Stripe API behavior and pagination cursor stability, not demonstrated by the code. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.
